findings.summary: reviewAuthoredLessonHandler at Phase 2 Green baseline (868b08b8) lacked a lesson-ownership check, allowing any teacher to approve/reject another teacher's submitted draft. The ownership gate was added in a subsequent tree commit (828a751f) and is now proven by a new adversarial test.

loadAuthoredLesson selects the 'latest' version with versions[versions.length - 1] rather than an explicit sort by version/createdAt. This relies on Convex insertion ordering and is a persistence-semantics fragility, but it is not a proven security blocker and was not introduced in Phase 2.

commits: f9038201 test(teacher-authoring): add adversarial test for cross-teacher review rejection
notes: Review B inspected the Phase 2 spec, plan, test-strategy, anti-patterns, and the changed source/test files. Teacher-scoped authz is enforced on every mutating handler except the review handler at baseline; that gap is closed in the current tree. Sanitization uses the real sanitizeLessonDraft before persistence; hashing and publish gating use computeComponentContentHash and reject stale approvals; student visibility requires published + class_lessons + active enrollment + same org. A2 (approval-aware publish gate) and A6 (tracks.md does not overstate completion) are satisfied. Lint (npm run ws:im3:lint) and tsc --noEmit both pass. Did NOT stage or commit _add_types.py, _add_types.ts, or measure/monorepo-ops.md.
